name: SLTS Verse
memo: Nirvana - Smells Like Teen Spirit: intro/verse. Clean amp + Small Clone-style chorus (Cobain used a Small Clone on the clean parts).

band.style_feel: driving straight eighths, heavy backbeat with snare on 2 and 4, kick on 1 and 3
parts: Part A: intro/verse - quiet, sparse drums and bass
Part C: chorus - full loud band
band.tips: Sources give roughly 116-118 BPM; tap the tempo against the record. Chords are F5, Bb5, Ab5, Db5. Strum steadily for 2 bars before the Trio+ starts learning each part.

name: SLTS Chorus
memo: Nirvana - Smells Like Teen Spirit: chorus/riff. Crunch amp + DS-1-style distortion, scooped mids (Mesa/Marshall + Boss DS-1).
